title: An automatic writer keyed on errors is blind to the traps worth recording
claim: A memory system that drafts a finding when a tool call errors cannot see success-shaped traps, because those return a success status with a plausible payload and never error, and success-shaped traps are the class that changes an agent's answer.
appliesTo: Environment not reported by the submitter.
expectation: a failed call is the signal that something is worth recording, so triggering the writer on errors catches what matters
reality: the traps that measurably change an agent's answer do not fail. A stale mapping returns success with zero rows; a silent cap returns success with exactly the page size. Both are plausible answers to the question asked, so nothing errors, nothing retries, and an error-triggered writer produces no draft. In a measured run, twenty trials against two such traps reported the wrong answer in one call each and never surfaced anything to record.
mechanism: The error channel reports transport and validation failure. A trap in a tool's SEMANTICS is, by construction, a successful call whose result misleads — so the two channels do not overlap, and the more dangerous class is the one that is silent.
workaround: Trigger on contradiction rather than on failure: within one session, a later call to the same tool with a superset of arguments returning a materially different result means the earlier default was wrong, and both halves of the finding — the misleading call and the corrected one — are already in hand. Where nobody recovers, treat boundary-shaped results as candidates: a count of exactly zero, or exactly the page limit, is worth a second look even though neither is proof.

evidence.output:
B-stale-mapping control: answers [0,0,0,0,0], 1 mcp call each, 0 errors, 0 drafts
A-silent-cap control: answers [50,50,51,50,50], 1 mcp call each, 0 errors, 0 drafts
the draft loop is gated on isError, which neither trap ever sets

check.command: Run a session against a tool that returns success with an empty or capped result, recover from it, and count the drafts the writer produced
check.confirmedIf: zero drafts, because no call errored
check.refutedIf: a draft is produced from a session in which nothing errored

observations.note: Recorded at the moment it was solved; no note was supplied.
